intro.h2: Custom cabinets in Moncure, NC, designed until they are right
paragraphs: Cabinet Creations builds custom cabinets in Moncure, NC, for kitchens, bathrooms, mudrooms, pantries, closets and living room built-ins. We are a family-owned business, and the owners stay involved from the first sketch to the last hinge. Craftsmanship and custom cabinets are what our Google reviews talk about most.

Customers notice how the design process works. One says Wayne will keep working on your design until it is exactly what you want. Another family got a call from Jennifer inviting them to visit their new kitchen while it was being laid out in our shop. A recent mudroom client says the quality shows in every joint, finish and detail.

items.name: Custom kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: Kitchens are where most of our customers start. We design the layout with you, build the boxes and doors in our shop and install them. One family was invited to see their kitchen laid out in the shop before it ever reached the house.

image.alt: Kitchen during installation: white shaker cabinets with glass-front uppers to the ceiling, a paneled range hood, tall pantry cabinets and an island waiting for its countertop

items.name: Mudrooms and laundry rooms
items.blurb: This mudroom and laundry pairs inset white cabinets with brass hardware, a farmhouse sink on a black counter and tall storage on the opposite wall. The homeowners say the finished cabinets went past what they had imagined, and they plan to use us again.

image.alt: Mudroom and laundry with stacked black washer and dryer, white inset cabinets, farmhouse sink on a black counter and patterned tile floor

items.name: Pantries and built-ins
items.blurb: Storage walls are a specialty. One customer's pantry got an eight-foot-wide custom buffet, and the same family had us build living room built-ins. The tall cabinet wall shown here runs floor to ceiling with long brass pulls, tucked drawers and doors that line up cleanly.

image.alt: Floor-to-ceiling white inset storage cabinets with long brass pulls and drawers beside a farmhouse sink and charcoal brick-look tile wall

items.name: Bathroom cabinets and vanities
items.blurb: Bathrooms deserve the same craftsmanship as the kitchen. We have built bathroom cabinetry as part of whole-house projects, sized to the room and finished to match the rest of the home, so the vanity feels like it was always meant to be there.

image.alt: White shaker double vanity with a center drawer bank, nickel pulls and a cream stone top under two white framed mirrors

items.name: Closets
items.blurb: A well-built closet changes how a bedroom works. One customer says our closet design was well thought out and the product and service were amazing, and she is already planning to talk with us about her kitchen next.

image.alt: Walk-in closet lined with white cabinetry: hanging rods, adjustable shelves and a long bank of drawers with a white top under sunny windows

items.name: Home offices and library walls
items.blurb: Built-ins can carry a whole room. One library wall runs side to side in soft blue-gray paint, with paneled doors below, mirror-backed shelves above and a rolling ladder on a rail. A home office got a long desk with two knee spaces, file drawers, a tall center cabinet and open shelves.

image.alt: Blue-gray library wall with paneled base cabinets, mirror-backed open shelves and a wooden rolling ladder on a rail, over a black and white diamond marble floor

about.text: Cabinet Creations is a family-owned cabinet maker on Moncure Pittsboro Road in Moncure, NC. Wayne leads the design work and Jennifer keeps customers in the loop, sometimes with an invitation to see their kitchen taking shape in our shop. We build kitchens, bathroom cabinetry, pantries, closets, mudrooms and living room built-ins, including one eight-foot custom buffet a customer still raves about. One family says we never made them feel rushed. The shop is open Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 3 PM and Friday from 9 AM to noon.

process.h2: From first sketch to installed cabinets

steps.title: Call the shop
steps.text: Call (919) 542-3722 Monday to Thursday, 9 AM to 3 PM, or Friday morning, and tell us which room you want to change.

steps.title: Design together
steps.text: We listen to how you use the room, offer suggestions from experience and keep adjusting the design until it is exactly right.

steps.title: Built in our shop
steps.text: Your cabinets are built in our Moncure shop. Sometimes we invite customers to come see their kitchen while it is being laid out.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: We install the cabinets in your home and fit doors, drawers and hardware so everything lines up and opens smoothly.

steps.title: Enjoy and come back
steps.text: Many customers return for the next room, from a closet to a kitchen, so we stay in touch once the job is done.

items.name: Shannon R.
items.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Exceptional Craftsmanship and Customer Care
From start to finish, Cabinet Creations exceeded our expectations for our mudroom renovation. What truly stood out was the genuine care and attention the owners brought to every single detail of our project. This family owned business is authentic and deeply invested in their work. You can tell they take pride in what they create.

The owners were remarkably responsive and involved throughout the entire process, always available to answer questions, address concerns, and collaborate on design decisions. They never made us feel rushed or like we were an inconvenience. Beyond their responsiveness, the owners proved to be incredibly personable and kind. They took the time to understand our vision, offered knowledgeable suggestions based on their extensive experience, and guided us through choices with patience and expertise. Their professionalism combined with genuine warmth made the whole experience enjoyable.

The end result speaks for itself—our custom cabinets are absolutely stunning and surpassed what we had even imagined. The quality of craftsmanship is evident in every joint, finish, and detail. We will absolutely be using Cabinet Creations for future projects and highly recommend them to anyone seeking custom cabinetry. There is truly nothing negative to say about our experience. Thank you for your beautiful work! The pictures speak for themselves!

items.name: Annette A.
items.text: Wayne and his team are AMAZING. The team understands that cabinets are important to you, and that you invest a lot of emotion in the design process.  Wayne will work with you on your design until it’s exactly what you want.  Jennifer called us one day and said we could come “visit” our new kitchen as they were laying it out in their shop. : )  All of their customer service was outstanding, and the team is professional & friendly. They did our kitchen, bathroom, pantry and living room built-ins and it’s absolutely beautiful. And that pantry? Holy cow! Wayne made us a 8’ wide custom buffet in there that you wouldn’t believe.  I cannot say enough good things about Cabinet Creations.

items.name: Helen F.
items.text: Wayne and his team did such an amazing job on our closet.  The product is amazing, the design is well thought out and their service was amazing.  We are excited to talk to them about redoing our kitchen - one day soon.

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets from our Moncure, NC shop
service_area.text: Cabinet Creations builds and installs custom cabinets from our shop at 4965 Moncure Pittsboro Rd in Moncure, NC. If you are planning a kitchen, bath, mudroom, pantry or closet and are not sure whether your home is within reach, call (919) 542-3722 during shop hours, tell us where you are and what you have in mind, and we will let you know.

items.q: What rooms do you build cabinets for?
items.a: Kitchens, bathrooms, pantries, closets, mudrooms and living room built-ins. Our reviews include a whole-house project with a kitchen, bathroom, pantry and built-ins, a closet, and a mudroom renovation. We also build one-off pieces, like the eight-foot custom buffet in one customer's pantry.

items.q: How does the design process work?
items.a: We start by understanding your vision and how you use the room, then offer suggestions based on experience. Wayne will keep working on the design with you until it is exactly what you want, and customers say we never made them feel rushed or like an inconvenience.

items.q: Can I see my cabinets before they are installed?
items.a: Often, yes. Your cabinets are built in our Moncure shop, and Jennifer once called a family to invite them to visit their new kitchen while it was being laid out there. Ask us when you place your order and we will let you know when it is a good time.

Yes. Cabinet Creations is family owned, and the owners are involved throughout every project, answering questions and helping with design decisions. One customer describes us as authentic, personable and kind, and says that genuine warmth made the whole experience an enjoyable one.

The shop is open Monday through Thursday from 9 AM to 3 PM and Friday from 9 AM to 12 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (919) 542-3722 during those hours, or visit us at 4965 Moncure Pittsboro Rd, Moncure, NC 27559.
